description: Planted-defect corpus measuring /audit's deterministic-scanner recall and precision. Each entry with planted=true is a defect a correct audit MUST catch; each planted=false entry is a negative control that a correct audit MUST NOT flag. Detector fields name the bench-local detector responsible for that class.
